verdicts.title: Symplectic, product and complex structures on 3-Lie algebras

verdicts.title: Geometric complexity theory for product-plus-power
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: According to Kumar's recent surprising result (ToCT'20), a small border Waring rank implies that the polynomial can be approximated as a sum of a constant and a small product of linear polynomials. We prove the converse of Kumar's result and establish a tight connection between border Waring rank and the model of computation in Kumar's result.
